title: Lost in Letterland III
summary: A winning MS replay collects all 275 chips and exits at tick 4176. TypeScript and native Tile World traces match exactly.
argument: The route follows the letters through their one-use chip strokes, preserving necessary crossings before exposing the underlying blocking tiles.
It releases the glider into the O entrance bomb, crosses the Q ice ring with released input between deliberate moves, and uses local Teeth lures through H, P, S, W and U.

The T chip at (22,21) is collected and Chip returns safely. After releasing its Tooth via (19,18), a sixteen-tick pause at (0,22) draws the approaching Teeth farther west before the descent through the green doors. A later loop through the lower rooms and upper corridor clears the return path.

A later detour uses still-covered green-door chips as barriers, draws the checkerboard Tooth into the lower key room, gathers all eight remaining blue keys and clears the lower-left chip room and four door chips.
After clearing the T dead end, lure the green-passage Teeth upstairs, loop through W and return behind them to reach X.

X requires a continuous traversal of its one-use wall chips and a loop around both Teeth. Collect its yellow key, spend all eight saved blue keys on Y, then walk back over the chips buried under those doors.
Clear the remaining Y and Z chips. Pass through the socket, take the provided flippers and fire boots after their respective burglar tiles, then enter the exit at (31,19).
The saved TWS completes the unchanged DAT in both the TypeScript and native Tile World MS engines at tick 4176. Every trace step matches; all 1000 recorded moves are cardinal keyboard commands.
